ttc_from_flow — DRIVE ttc op

• Data kinds: image2d × image2d → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.ttc_from_flow(u, v, dt: 'float', *, foe=None, mask=None, min_speed: 'float' = 0.001, at_first_frame: 'bool' = True) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import drivettc; drivettc.ttc_from_flow(u, v, dt: 'float', *, foe=None, mask=None, min_speed: 'float' = 0.001, at_first_frame: 'bool' = True) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("ttc_from_flow"))

Usage

τ (seconds) from optical flow: {"tau_map", "tau", "n", "foe"}.

Converts sceneflow.time_to_contact (per pixel, in frames, radius² from the FoE / radial flow) to seconds. The flow from a 2-frame difference gives τ at the time of the 2nd frame (Z₁ / (Z₀ − Z₁) frames), so at_first_frame=True (default) adds 1 frame to give τ at the first frame (exact for constant velocity; the same time as ttc_truth). If foe is omitted it is estimated from the flow (sceneflow.focus_of_expansion). The true FoE is foe_from_motion. tau is the median of finite, positive τ within mask (all pixels if omitted) (inf if none), and n is the number of those pixels.
